contract.name: Recovered dash and walking controller
contract.scope: Standalone 60Hz movement only: walking, dash activation/active motion, direction storage, cooldown. Excludes registries, allocation, damage, scoring, rendering and effects; no cartridge/runtime/assets.
contract.stateDescription: JSON state {dirX,dirY,remaining,cooldown,cooldownFresh}: float32 dash direction (initial 0,0), int remaining dash ticks, int cooldown ticks initialized from initialCooldownTicks and decremented on non-dash ticks.

rules.description: Cooldown decrements once per non-dash tick when >0; initial 10 shows 9 after tick 1, and dash is blocked until cooldown was 0 at tick start.
Activation requires X (bit1) held/pressed with cooldown 0, even if held continuously; retrigger occurs on first tick after cooldown reaches 0 on a prior tick.
On activation set cooldown=cooldownTicks, emit dash-start, move same tick; cooldown does not decrement during dash.
Dash lasts sourceBodyWidth ticks (8 ticks at width 8) moving fround(dashDistance/width) per tick along direction; dash-end on last tick when remaining transitions to 0; ownsMotion on all dash ticks.
Input direction from left16/right32/up64/down128, float32-normalized (func102); conflicting axes cancel. During dash direction is frozen despite input changes.
Dash activation with zero input direction reuses stored direction, defaulting to (1,0) when stored is zero; new directional activation replaces stored direction.
When not dashing, walking displacement is normalized input direction times walkingSpeed in float32, including diagonals and zero for cancelled inputs.

limitations: Dash duration inferred as sourceBodyWidth ticks with per-tick dashDistance/width; traces only confirm this at width 8, distance 60.
Only X activation is evidenced; Z and other buttons have no observed dash effect and are ignored.
Exact float32 rounding of donor sqrt/division approximated with Math.fround operations.
